name: Hawaiian Huli Huli Chicken with Macaroni Salad and Grilled Pineapple (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
2 stick celery
1 small pineapple

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add soy sauce, ketchup, water, vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and smoked paprika to the pan with the ginger and garlic. Whisk to combine the sauce, then bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp ketchup
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
brown sugar
2 tsp cornstarch
½ tsp smoked paprika

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), add salt, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain in a colander, rinse under cold water to cool, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
8 oz macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: While the pasta is cooking, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Add half of the sauce and turn to coat. (Reserve remaining sauce for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add chicken (discarding any excess sauce in the bowl) and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean medium bowl, add remaining sauce, and turn to coat. Loosely cover with aluminum foil and set aside. (Reserve pan for later use.)

Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, sugar, and spices in an another clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing, then add cooled pasta and stir to combine. Transfer 1 cup of dressed macaroni to a plate (leaving the rest in the bowl).
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tsp brown sugar
½ tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve one stick of celery lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 2-inch long pieces. Add to the plate with the dressed macaroni. Trim and small dice remaining celery, then add to the bowl.
Peel and trim carrots. Quarter one carrot lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 2-inch long sticks. Add to the plate and set aside. Coarsely grate remaining carrot and add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and coarsely grate onion. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the macaroni salad, and set aside.

Cut off skin from pineapple, then quarter and core. Medium dice half of the flesh, add to the plate with the dressed macaroni and veggies, then set aside. Cut remaining pineapple into 3-inch long sticks, place on another plate, and sprinkle with Tajin seasoning.
Return pan to medium-high heat, add seasoned pineapple, and grill, turning occasionally, until charred and tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Cut two chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces, then divide between plates, along with plain macaroni salad, veggie sticks, and diced pineapple. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining chicken thighs, macaroni salad, and grilled pineapple between plates. Enjoy!
